mechanism_boundary.closed_control: A linear isotropic identity-source response with one fixed long range is the STVG/MOG or linear nonlocal control. It failed the frozen joint structural test and cannot be revived by renaming its strength, length, or Fourier exponent.
mechanism_boundary.active_hypothesis_class: One nonlinear, baryon-forced, source-state-sensitive long-wave metric response whose orientation and activation follow covariantly from baryonic density, current, pressure, stress, overlap, and causal assembly state.

priority.first: Broad galaxy and cluster transfer using development and spent evidence, followed by untouched holdouts only after the action and constants are frozen.
priority.second: Consequences for other phenomena commonly attributed to dark matter, beginning with observables computable from the same quasistatic metric and then extending to cosmological perturbations.
priority.later_hard_exclusion_gate: Solar-System, binary-pulsar, PPN, propagation-speed, radiation-loss, stability, and causal initial-value tests.

other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.prediction_required: Tangential and cross shear, reduced shear, magnification, and their scale dependence from the same Weyl potential used for strong lensing.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.long_wave_signature: A universal coherence length predicts a common physical-scale bend; source-state anisotropy predicts non-radial shear tied to baryonic geometry.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.minimum_data: Lens/source redshifts, calibrated shapes, boost and selection corrections, stellar and gas baryon models, covariance, and random-point nulls.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.theory_prerequisite: Weak-field metric potentials and a line-of-sight solver.

other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.prediction_required: Convergence, shear, critical curves, and image roots relative to independently measured gas, galaxies, and intracluster light through time.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.long_wave_signature: A causal source-state field may lag, lead, or redirect baryonic gravity during a merger; the displacement and orientation must be predicted from the measured state, not fit to a halo map.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.minimum_data: Multiwavelength baryon maps, member velocities, gas temperature and shock state, raw strong/weak lensing catalogs, and projection uncertainty.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.theory_prerequisite: Retarded source-state evolution and one physical metric.

other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.prediction_required: Line-of-sight velocity-dispersion profiles, escape speeds, tidal radii, and host-distance dependence without assigning a halo to each satellite.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.long_wave_signature: The host and satellite baryonic sources overlap within one long mode, producing a calculable environmental or external-field response.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.minimum_data: Membership probabilities, binary-star treatment, stellar density, anisotropy nuisance model, proper motions, orbit, and host baryon model.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.theory_prerequisite: Three-dimensional nonlinear field solver and massive-particle geodesics.

other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.prediction_required: Stream track, precession, width, density gaps, and strong-lens flux or astrometric perturbations from baryons plus the Sigma field.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.long_wave_signature: A smooth tens-of-kpc response should alter global stream precession but cannot imitate arbitrary compact dark subhalos unless baryonic or self-generated field structure produces them.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.minimum_data: Six-dimensional stream phase space, baryonic perturber inventory, time-dependent host baryons, lens imaging, and selection functions.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.theory_prerequisite: Time-dependent nonlinear solutions and a prediction for whether the field forms compact self-structures.

other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.prediction_required: Orbital-energy and angular-momentum loss for satellites, bars, globular clusters, and merging galaxies.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.long_wave_signature: Without particle dark-matter wakes, dissipation must arise from baryons and radiation or excitation of the Sigma field; the action fixes the sign and rate.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.minimum_data: Orbital phase space, baryonic mass models, ages, bar pattern speeds, and merger-stage constraints.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.theory_prerequisite: Field energy, radiation, retarded response, and backreaction derived from the action.

other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.prediction_required: Background expansion, scale-dependent linear growth, gravitational slip, redshift-space distortions, nonlinear clustering, halo-free collapse, and cosmic shear.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.long_wave_signature: The fixed physical or comoving interpretation of the coherence length creates a specific scale and redshift dependence that cannot be chosen independently at each epoch.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.minimum_data: Galaxy clustering and RSD covariances, weak-lensing tomography, BAO distances, peculiar velocities, and baryon feedback models.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.theory_prerequisite: Covariant cosmological background and perturbation equations with initial conditions.

other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.prediction_required: Acoustic peak positions and heights, early and late integrated Sachs-Wolfe effects, damping tail, and CMB lensing power with no cold-dark-matter density inserted.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.long_wave_signature: The field must supply the pre-recombination potential evolution normally stabilized by dark matter while remaining consistent with its late-time galactic scale.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.minimum_data: Temperature, polarization, and lensing likelihoods with foreground nuisance models and a baryon-only background inventory.
other_dark_matter_attributed_phenomena.theory_prerequisite: Relativistic background and Boltzmann perturbation implementation.

claim_boundary: Passing this protocol proves coverage and sequencing discipline, not that a long-wave Sigma theory fits any observation.
The exact isotropic radial long-wave control is already closed; only a materially different source-state-dependent action may advance.
Model-derived CLASH and RELICS lens maps may generate hypotheses but may not validate the theory.
The other-phenomena entries are forward-prediction obligations; they are not post-hoc explanations or completed tests.
Detailed Solar work is deprioritized, not waived; the final theory still must pass every local and relativistic exclusion gate.
